text:
rachel.design: Quick note from today's usability check: when runs have back-to-back tool calls, users miss which call failed schema validation. Need a more scannable cue.

sam.devex: Agreed. Idea: compact inline badge next to the tool header that shows status + short reason. Click opens a small anchored panel with a 1-line diff preview.

owen.product: Product asks that badges don't push content down. Pref overlay/popover anchored to the header and a link to open the right-side inspector. Also add run-history filter: "Only runs with validation issues".

meera.a11y: A11y must be explicit: badge should be focusable, have aria-label like "Schema validation for CheckoutV2: mismatch", use aria-expanded/aria-controls, and the popover should manage focus (trap and restore). Announce new validation via aria-live="polite" on run completion.

liam.runtime: Backend will add a lite `validation_summary` string and `schema_fingerprint` on invocation payloads. Example string: "missing price". Full diffs computed async; client shows loader when requesting full inspector.

sam.devex: UX details: badge = [SchemaName] [icon] [short text <=16 chars]. Keyboard: Enter/Space opens popover, Esc closes. Popover monospace diff snippet, CTA "Open full inspector". Use icons + text (no color-only).

rachel.design: Copy ideas: badge text options: "OK", "Mismatch", "Partial match". Tooltip: "Schema: CheckoutV2 — Press Enter to inspect". Avoid label "raw"; use "Open JSON view".

meera.a11y: Also include visible keyboard hint in the popover footer and link it with aria-describedby. Make sure screen readers read the popover content on open.

ci-bot: CI: visual diff job queued for playground-run-detail badge changes.

owen.product: Next steps: liam to add API fields, rachel to mock variants in Figma, meera to review a11y labels, sam to prototype client behavior. Drop mocks here when ready. :sparkles:
